description: Multi-stream session — 23 rows partitioned across 4 streams. The harness verifies the decoded row set is identical, not that the per-stream slicing matches.
insertSql: INSERT INTO $TABLE SELECT id, FORMAT('row-%d', id) AS name FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(1, 23)) AS id
localInsertSql: INSERT INTO $TABLE SELECT i AS id, 'row-' || i::VARCHAR AS name FROM generate_series(1, 23) AS t(i)
